summary: Ranged poke champion who swaps between cannon and hammer forms. He bullies melee champions from range, then dives in with Hammer Q for burst. He's mana-hungry and squishy, so anyone who can reach him or tank the poke beats him.
threats: Cannon Q (Shock Blast) through E (Acceleration Gate) is long-range poke; stay behind minions.
Hammer E (Thundering Blow) knocks you away, and he uses it to escape when you finally reach him.
Hammer Q (To the Skies) is a gap closer for burst all-ins.
He's mana-hungry; once he's low on mana, he can't trade.

matchups.why: Pantheon's W (Shield Vault) is a point-and-click dash and stun that reaches Jayce from range, and E (Aegis Assault) blocks his Shock Blast from the front. Pantheon wins every trade once he closes the gap.
trading: W onto him when he walks up, then Q + autos during the stun.
E to block his Shock Blast when he pokes; face him while you do.
Don't walk at him in a straight line; dodge his gated Q.
After W, walk back if he's used Hammer E; don't get knocked into his tower.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are yours: he can't out-trade a stun into Q burst. Trade aggressively and deny his farm.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives roam pressure; use it if he's hiding under tower.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash; take plates while he can't stop you.
matchups.jungle: W stun is easy gank setup. Call your jungler when he pushes past mid-lane.
matchups.remember: Block the Shock Blast, then stun.

matchups.why: Jayce's poke is physical, so Malphite's armor and shield absorb most of it. Malphite's targeted Q poke chips him from range, and once Malphite has R, Jayce can't safely stand anywhere in lane.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him whenever he walks up to poke; it's targeted and he can't dodge it.
Stand behind your minions so his Shock Blast hits them, not you.
Keep Granite Shield up; walk out of poke range to let it recharge after it pops.
If he Hammer-Q's in, E (Ground Slam) to slow his attack speed and trade back.
matchups.early: Farm safely behind minions and Q poke. Build armor early to blunt his poke.
matchups.spike: At 5, R lets you engage on him from range with your jungler.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; he can't dive you through your armor.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when he's pushed past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Grasp of the Undying. Plated Steelcaps and early armor.
matchups.remember: Armor up, Q poke, wait for R.

matchups.why: Both are ranged poke champions. Kennen's stun interrupts Jayce's all-in and E (Lightning Rush) dodges his gated Q, but Jayce out-ranges Kennen with gated Shock Blast. The lane comes down to who wins the poke war.
trading: Q (Thundering Shuriken) poke when he walks up to farm; each hit builds your stun marks.
E (Lightning Rush) sideways when he places Acceleration Gate; gated Shock Blast is his only real damage.
If he Hammer-Q's in with two marks on him, W (Electrical Surge) for the stun and trade back.
Stand behind your minions so his ungated Shock Blast explodes on them.
matchups.early: Even. Trade poke and don't take his gated Q for free; he spends a lot of mana doing it.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus stun stops his all-in; his poke still trades evenly.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade poke when his Q is on cooldown.
matchups.jungle: He's an easy gank target when he's low on mana and can't use Hammer E to escape.
matchups.build: Electrocute. AP items; early boots for dodging.
matchups.remember: Dodge the gate, stun the dive.

matchups.why: Jayce pokes Darius out of lane with gated Shock Blast, and Hammer E knocks Darius away mid-combo. Darius can only win if he lands E pull, and Jayce rarely gives him the chance.
trading: Stand behind minions to block his Shock Blast.
E (Apprehend) pull him only when he's in range and Hammer E is on cooldown.
Once you land E, stack Hemorrhage immediately; he'll try to knock you off.
Don't chase him through his tower range.
matchups.early: Farm safely behind minions. Accept some poke and wait for him to overextend.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives kill threat if you land E. One pull plus R can kill him from half HP.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; don't walk into his poke.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; he's squishy once he's out of position.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Ghost for chasing. Armor boots early.
matchups.remember: Wait behind minions, pull when Hammer E is down.

matchups.why: Jayce matches Teemo's range and far out-pokes him with gated Shock Blast. Teemo's blind only stops autos, and Jayce's damage is mostly spells, so Teemo loses every range trade.
trading: Stand behind minions to block his Shock Blast.
Blind him when he Hammer-Q's in, then Move Quick away.
Poke him only when his Q is on cooldown.
Place mushrooms at 5 to block his approach.
matchups.early: Farm safely behind minions and accept some poke. Don't try to win range trades with him.
matchups.spike: At 5 your mushrooms make his all-ins risky. Place them on his approach paths and in river.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower with autos.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; he's squishy once he's out of position.
matchups.build: Electrocute. AP items; MR boots aren't needed (his damage is physical).
matchups.remember: Hide behind minions, shroom the approach.
